name: Skorn Whitecloud
summary: Skorn Whitecloud is an aging tauren hunter residing at Bloodhoof Village in the rolling plains of Mulgore. He guides young hunters in understanding their relationship with the land's predators and aids travelers who cross paths with Mulgore's lurking dangers.

sections.title: A Guide on the Golden Plains
sections.body: Living at Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore, Skorn Whitecloud is an old hunter who now serves as an instructor in the ways of the hunt. His primary role is instilling respect for the wild creatures of the plains. He tests aspiring hunters by sending them after the claws of Mulgore's cunning flatland prowlers, to be shown to Melor Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff, ensuring that those who take up the bow or spear understand the balance between predator and prey.

sections.title: Vigilance Against the Unnatural
sections.body: Beyond ordinary hunting duties, Skorn remains watchful for strange disturbances across the savannah. When unnatural threats surface—such as signs of demonic corruption left upon the wildlife and beasts of the plains—Skorn helps piece together what transpired, ensuring the tribes of Mulgore remain alert to malevolent forces creeping into their ancestral home.

faq.q: Where can Skorn Whitecloud be found?
faq.answer: Skorn Whitecloud is located at Bloodhoof Village, the tauren settlement in the southern grasslands of Mulgore.

faq.q: What role does Skorn play for young hunters?
faq.answer: Skorn teaches the core principles of hunting through the rite known as The Hunter's Way. He tasks aspiring hunters with proving their tracking and combat skills against the plains' cunning flatland prowlers, then sends them to Melor Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff.
Skorn is no merchant. His hunting days are over, but he offers one of his own weapons, Skorn's Hammer or Skorn's Rifle, to the hunter who brings him proof that the great wolf Ghost Howl has fallen.

faq.q: Is Skorn Whitecloud related to any other tauren in Mulgore?
faq.answer: He shares a surname with Provisioner Whitecloud, a tauren merchant residing at Bloodhoof Village, suggesting ties to the same extended tribal family.

angles.text: For young tauren hunters, Skorn Whitecloud offers early guidance in stalking swift predators like the flatland prowler, reinforcing the spiritual harmony of the hunt.
Skorn exemplifies the Whitecloud family's dedication to providing shelter, weaponry, and practical wisdom across the scattered settlements of Mulgore.
